job.job_description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in backend and frontend technologies. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in designing scalable applications, database architecture, cloud deployment, and containerized environments.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop and maintain scalable web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
Build REST APIs and microservices using Python and Node.js.
Develop responsive and dynamic user interfaces using React.js.
Design optimized and scalable database schemas.
Work with AWS cloud services for deployment and infrastructure management.
Implement containerization and deployment using Docker.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including QA, DevOps, and Product teams.
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance.
Follow best coding practices, security standards, and software development lifecycle processes.
Required Skills:
Strong experience in Python development frameworks (Django/FastAPI/Flask).
Strong experience with Node.js and backend API development.
Expertise in React.js and frontend architecture.
Strong knowledge of database design and schema optimization (MySQL/PostgreSQL/MongoDB).
Hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, etc.).
Experience with Docker and containerized application deployment.
Good understanding of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with Kubernetes or DevOps tools.
Knowledge of microservices architecture.
Experience working with AI/ML-based applications is a plus.
Candidate Requirements:
4+ years of professional full-stack development experience.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
Ability to work independently and manage project deliverables efficiently
